_comment: Shipped decisions of the elementary-flow ladder (engine/backgrounds/flow_mapping.py, rung 'fallback'). Names only: 'name' is the source flow as the ecoSpold-1 database writes it (after the generic rewrites: unit suffix, region and 'process' dropped), 'compartment' its top-level ecoinvent compartment ('*' = any), 'target' the target flow BY NAME ('null' = keep as a new flow of its own, even if a heuristic rung finds something), 'target_categories' only where the target lives in another compartment. No identifiers of any database appear here (BYOD rule); every entry carries its reason. Decided 04.09.2026 against BAFU:2026 v1 and ecoinvent 3.12, see docs/DATENHERKUNFT.md.

flows.name: Water, fossil
flows.reason: Formation water withdrawn with oil and gas; ecoinvent 3 books exactly this withdrawal as water of unspecified natural origin (its own petroleum datasets do).

flows.name: Water, unspecified
flows.reason: Bare 'unspecified' water (after the region suffix is dropped) is the generic withdrawal flow.

flows.name: Water, well
flows.reason: ecoinvent 3 names the well flow with its origin; there is exactly one well-water flow.

flows.name: Water, surface
flows.reason: Surface water without further qualification: the river flow is ecoinvent 3's generic surface withdrawal (lake is the other, rarer one).

flows.name: Waste water
flows.reason: Waste water returned to a water body is the water emission of the same sub-compartment; kilograms become cubic metres through the unit table.

flows.name: Chemically polluted water
flows.reason: Same as waste water: the returned volume; the pollutants are separate exchanges in the source dataset.

flows.name: Particulates
flows.reason: Particulates without a size class: booked as the coarse fraction — the conservative choice for total-PM emissions (mechanical dust dominates); PM2.5 is a separate flow where the source knows it.

flows.name: Particulates, < 10 um
flows.reason: PM10 as a total has no flow in ecoinvent 3 (only fractions). The coarse fraction carries the PM10 factors of Ecological Scarcity and EF; PM2.5 of the same dataset is booked separately by the source.

flows.name: Particulates, < 10 um (stationary)
flows.reason: As above; the emitter type is not a flow property in ecoinvent 3.

flows.name: Carbon dioxide
flows.reason: Unqualified CO2 is booked as fossil (conservative; the source uses the explicit 'biogenic' flow where it means biogenic).

flows.name: Bauxite
flows.reason: Kilograms of ore are not kilograms of aluminium; the CAS rung would land on an aluminium-in-bauxite flow. Kept as its own flow.

flows.name: Uranium
flows.reason: Uranium as a mass emission to water; ecoinvent 3 knows only isotopes in kBq. No mass-to-activity conversion without the isotope mix.
